text:
anna_sales: MerchantOne signed. They need sustained 5k RPS, 2x 10min bursts, 200ms p95. Asking for reserved GPUs + burst credits pricing. Can eng confirm resource plan + autoscale rules?

mike_sre: Quick clarify  single-turn gen avg tokens?

anna_sales: Yes, mostly single-turn, avg ~350 tokens; rerank ~8%.

jun_prod: With seq~350 and a batching cap to keep p95<200ms, practical throughput ~800 RPS per A100-eq GPU. Recommend 7 reserved GPUs. KV/prefix cache warm improves throughput ~20-25%.

lina_infra: For 2x short bursts add a 5-GPU burst pool (spot-backed recommended). Preheat 10m before campaign to warm KV. Preheat sample: `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.example/v1/preheat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"job":"kv_warm","model":"merchant-chat","start_in":"10m","duration_mins":15}'`

nate_se: Security Qs answered: CMEK/KMS supported, VPC peering OK, audit logs exportable, SOC2 addendum ~5 business days. Need key alias + IAM role for onboarding.

mike_sre: Autoscale proposal: monitor 30s RPS avg, trigger scale-up when >85% reserved for 60s, cooldown 120s. Burst pool used until max; if burst not ready within 120s, auto-fallback to quantized-8bit model. If capacity still constrained, return HTTP 429 for excess requests and notify via webhook. Draft SLA blurb prepared.

anna_sales: Action items: (1) @jun_prod perf table + conservative GPU counts by EOD. (2) @lina_infra runbook + preheat snippet. (3) @nate_se security checklist + SOC2 timeline. (4) @mike_sre finalize SLA paragraph. I'll bundle for finance/legal.

ops_bot: Note: Dedicated provisioning needs RFC ticket + AZ affinity: https://rfd.redwood.example/reqs/9999
